verification_method: Read official Hugging Face Inference Providers model/provider rows and cross-check Nscale-supported model list. These are listing snapshots, not guaranteed future prices or inference tests.

1.comparison_note: Task-based 4B instruct proxy for a 135M local model (about 30x larger); no size or quality equivalence claimed.

2.comparison_note: Task-based 4B instruct proxy for a nominal 0.5B local model (about 8x larger); no quality equivalence claimed.

3.comparison_note: Task-based 4B instruct proxy for a 1.7B local model (about 2.4x larger); different training and capabilities.

4.comparison_note: Similar-size 4B instruct proxy for Phi-3.5 3.8B; different family and no demonstrated quality equivalence.

5.comparison_note: Same Qwen3-8B model ID; hosted precision and thinking configuration are unverified, unlike local NF4 non-thinking run.

6.comparison_note: Task-based 4B instruct proxy for a 135M local model (about 30x larger); same proxy Lin used for Model 1, reused unchanged per Stage 1's established reasoning; no size or quality equivalence claimed.

7.comparison_note: Task-based 4B instruct proxy for a 0.6B local model (about 6.7x larger); no size or quality equivalence claimed.

8.comparison_note: Task-based 4B instruct proxy for a ~2B local model (about 2x larger); different model family, no quality equivalence claimed.

9.comparison_note: Same base model and nominal parameter count (4B) as the local model, but a different instruct checkpoint (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 vs. the base Qwen3-4B run locally); the closest size match of any Stage 2 proxy, though hosted precision, thinking configuration and the instruct-tuning difference remain unverified against the local run.

10.comparison_note: Reuses Stage 1's Very Large proxy (Qwen3-8B/nscale). This paid 8B model is actually SMALLER than the local 12B Mistral-Nemo (4-bit NF4); no size or quality equivalence claimed. Chosen because it is nscale's largest currently-verified listed model in this evidence set.

11.comparison_note: Task-based 4B instruct proxy for a 360M local model (about 11x larger); same proxy Lin used for Models 1-4 and Rishabh for Models 6-9, re-read from the official listing on 2026-10-24; no size or quality equivalence claimed.

12.comparison_note: Task-based 4B instruct proxy for a 1.5B local model (about 2.7x larger); same Qwen2.5 family is not hosted on this listing; different generation and training; no size or quality equivalence claimed.

13.comparison_note: Task-based 4B instruct proxy for a 3B local model (about 1.3x larger); closest-sized listed instruct model, but a different generation (Qwen3 vs Qwen2.5); no size or quality equivalence claimed.

14.comparison_note: Closest listed size to the local 7B model (about 1.1x larger); reuses the Qwen3-8B/nscale quote Lin and Rishabh recorded (Stage 2 re-verification date 2026-10-22), not re-read on 2026-10-24; different generation, and Qwen3-8B thinking behavior and hosted precision are unverified versus local NF4 non-thinking Qwen2.5-7B; no size or quality equivalence claimed.

15.comparison_note: Same nominal size as the local 14.7B Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, but a different generation (Qwen3 vs Qwen2.5); hosted precision and thinking behavior are unverified versus local NF4; listed context is 40,960 tokens; no quality equivalence claimed.
